catch-all for objects originating in mainland Italy between the end of the First Punic War ca. 241 BCE to the founding of Constantinople in 330 CE. This period roughly corresponds to Rome[X]s dominance of the peninsula and all of its cities, including formerly Greek colonies to the south. During this period, Italy was a region with a relatively stable collection of cultural traditions distinct from the rest of the Mediterranean world. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ancient_Rome
